## Requirements

Building the API client library requires:
1. Java 1.8+
2. Maven (3.8.3+)/Gradle (7.2+)

## Installation

To install the API client library to your local Maven repository, simply execute:

```shell
mvn clean install
```

To deploy it to a remote Maven repository instead, configure the settings of the repository and execute:

```shell
mvn clean deploy
```

Refer to the [OSSRH Guide](http://central.sonatype.org/pages/ossrh-guide.html) for more information.

### Maven users

Add this dependency to your project's POM:

```xml
<dependency>
  <groupId>com.junsong</groupId>
  <artifactId>junsong-open-sdk</artifactId>
  <version>1.0.0</version>
  <scope>compile</scope>
</dependency>
```

### Gradle users

Add this dependency to your project's build file:

```groovy
  repositories {
    mavenCentral()     // Needed if the 'junsong-open-sdk' jar has been published to maven central.
    mavenLocal()       // Needed if the 'junsong-open-sdk' jar has been published to the local maven repo.
  }

  dependencies {
     implementation "com.junsong:junsong-open-sdk:1.0.0"
  }
```

### Others

At first generate the JAR by executing:

```shell
mvn clean package
```

Then manually install the following JARs:

* `target/junsong-open-sdk-1.0.0.jar`
* `target/lib/*.jar`

## Getting Started

Please follow the [installation](#installation) instruction and execute the following Java code:

```java

// Import classes:
import com.junsong.open.ApiClient;
import com.junsong.open.ApiException;
import com.junsong.open.Configuration;
import com.junsong.open.auth.*;
import com.junsong.open.model.*;
import com.junsong.open.api.OpenAppControllerApi;

public class Example {
  public static void main(String[] args) {
    ApiClient defaultClient = Configuration.getDefaultApiClient();
    defaultClient.setBasePath("http://localhost:8080/junsong-open");
    
    // Configure API key authorization: apikey
    ApiKeyAuth apikey = (ApiKeyAuth) defaultClient.getAuthentication("apikey");
    apikey.setApiKey("YOUR API KEY");
    // Uncomment the following line to set a prefix for the API key, e.g. "Token" (defaults to null)
    //apikey.setApiKeyPrefix("Token");

    OpenAppControllerApi apiInstance = new OpenAppControllerApi(defaultClient);
    OpenApp openApp = new OpenApp(); // OpenApp | 
    try {
      AjaxResult result = apiInstance.add(openApp);
      System.out.println(result);
    } catch (ApiException e) {
      System.err.println("Exception when calling OpenAppControllerApi#add");
      System.err.println("Status code: " + e.getCode());
      System.err.println("Reason: " + e.getResponseBody());
      System.err.println("Response headers: " + e.getResponseHeaders());
      e.printStackTrace();
    }
  }
}

```
